text:
alex: Quick question — I'm tuning alerts for ACME's eu-west traffic. Where do we keep saved LogSearch queries for route /api/generate (looking for 5xx + latency spikes, last 24h)?

kira: We have a saved view but the name is a bit old. Try 'acme-eu-errors-v2' in LogSearch.

jamal: Pasting the canonical query we use for that saved view (should work in LogSearch):
```
org:acme AND route:"/api/generate" AND region:eu-west AND (status:[500 TO 599] OR status:>=500) AND @lat_ms:>1000
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 100
```
Link to saved view: https://logsearch.redwood.ai/app/discover?saved=view:acme-eu-errors-v2 (may need VPN)

oncall-bot: ALERT: acme-eu-route-5xx is firing (count=42 in last 10m). See: https://alerts.redwood.ai/alert/ACME-EU-5xx

alex: Thanks — that's exactly what I needed. Two follow-ups: 1) should the alert threshold be 30 or 50 for this route? 2) can we add a sliding-window avg latency check to avoid noisy fires? :thinking:

kira: I'd start with 50 for now (we're getting some benign bursts from batch jobs). For latency, add a separate rule that triggers when avg(@lat_ms) > 1200 over 5m — less noisy. I can open a PR to the alerting playbook.

jamal: I'll update the saved search to include a filter tag `source:public-api` so it's easier to find. Also adding a dashboard panel: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/acme-eu-route-panel?orgId=acme

alex: Perfect. @kira please ping when you open the PR and @jamal when the saved view is updated. Closing the loop after changes. :thumbsup:
